rules.text: W-FBW-1W (signal wiring) and B-WAI-L (bleed or hot air duct) come within 44.8 mm (1.8 in) in Z-CWB, closer than the 152.4 mm (6 in) minimum (the program's own figure: Aeolus EWIS installation standard AES-24-002 section 4.3: 6 in from bleed ducts, or a heat shield.; 14 CFR 25.1707(g)).

close.text: SFN-FCS2: the routes of channel 1 (Left aileron actuators, line H-A-01) and channel 2 (Right aileron actuators, line H-B-01) come within 80 mm of each other in Z-CWB, closer than the 150 mm the program requires.

SFN-NZD3: the routes of channel 1 (Lock proximity sensor, channel 1, line W-NZD-LOCK-1) and channel 2 (Lock proximity sensor, channel 2, line W-NZD-LOCK-2) come within 85 mm of each other in Z-NZDR, closer than the 150 mm the program requires.
